mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 10%) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 10.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 10.0 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signals contraction in both supply and demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal (INDPRO < 95 and HOUST < 1000) has a Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter (Q1 2020 < Q4 2019) signals recessionary conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors react to deteriorating economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of recessionary GDP decline periods, or the Rank IC for GDP decline is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL_yoy > 3.0) signals high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central banks tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL_yoy > 3.0), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL_yoy > 3.0 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% (FEDFUNDS < 1.0) signals an active monetary easing cycle, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as low interest rates support equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 1.0 is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A real interest rate below 1.0% (FEDFUNDS minus year-over-year CPI change < 1.0) signals an accommodative monetary environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the low real rate supports equity investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL_yoy < 1.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the slowdown in supply chains impacts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 90 is negative.
